#Importing needed packages

library(data.table) library(ggplot2) library(maps)

#Importing the file with individual wood density
measurements(xdm_individual_density_data.csv file)
XDM_individual_density_data =
data.table(read.table("xdm_individual_density_data.csv", sep = ",", dec
= ".", header = TRUE))

# Création d'un tableau avec uniquement 1 espèce : Quercus robur

library(dplyr) dta_Qrobur = filter(XDM_individual_density_data,
XDM_individual_density_data\$Species == "Quercus robur")
